annotations.title: Calculate a Swedish monthly mortgage cost

description: Local-only Swedish mortgage calculator (all amounts SEK). Returns the monthly cost broken into interest, mandated amortisation (amorteringskrav from LTV, rules as of 1 April 2026), BRF fee (avgift), and operating cost — with both gross and after-tax (ränteavdrag) totals. Provide `down_payment` OR `down_payment_percent` (defaults to the legal 10% minimum). No network call.

amortization_rate.description: Override the computed amortisation rate (annual % of loan).

down_payment_percent.description: Percent of price; defaults to the legal 10% minimum.

gross_yearly_income.description: Deprecated and ignored: income no longer affects amortisation (the debt-ratio rule was abolished 1 April 2026).

monthly_fee.description: BRF monthly fee (avgift) in SEK — for bostadsrätt apartments.

monthly_operating_cost.description: Monthly operating cost (driftkostnad) in SEK — typically houses.

name: hemnet_calculate_mortgage
